notes: «- المعنى واحد -» is a gloss and is left out; «قالا» puts the two named men in one level
«عمر بن الخطاب» is the speaker of «سمعت رسول الله»: the Companion who says he heard the Prophet is the last link (rule 6); Abu Umama reports his act and words
«وقد رواه يحيى بن أيوب عن عبيد الله بن زحر» names different transmitters for the same saying: a variant group, not a route of this saying
